question: Pseudopodia are finger-like extensions on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amoeba.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Pseudopodia** (singular pseudopodium) are temporary **arm-like projections** or extensions of the body of a microorganism, filled with cytoplasm. 
 
• The organism can **change the shape and size** of the pseudopodia, making it **able to move.**
 
• The pseudopodia are also used as a** tool to capture prey. **
 
• They are often found in **amoebas **and other **protozoa. **
